Cell characters, round 2

Brief 012 · Forma · 2026-10-15 · 136 images (A 45, B 56, C 23, D 12) · Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo spend $1.752 of the $3.00 ceiling (probe included) · Codex image tool free. Thumbnails are embedded; click any image for the full file. Per-image model, prompt, refs, seed, cost, sha256: PROVENANCE.json.

Top 8

A. Unify the picks

Sky's four locked picks (Scout S1-2, Fixer P4-6, Tech F2-1, Enforcer G3), same faces, bodies, hair and silhouettes, one finish. Gold becomes chrome or matte metal; violet becomes the cell accent; the Tech's glow is calmed to a dark unlit visor; the Enforcer's amber glasses go neutral smoke grey (amber is the guard signal). Three accents: white-on-charcoal, deep teal-black, deep sienna-brown (a mid burnt sienna measured only ΔE 14 from the cones, so the accent is the dark one).

A. HUD portraits, Codex (rows: white-on-charcoal, teal-black, sienna; Scout, Fixer, Tech, Enforcer)

A. Same brief on Qwen Turbo with the picks as reference

Qwen takes reference images (inputs.referenceImages, prompt extend off) and keeps identity well, but follows the edits less strictly: the Tech's strips still glow faintly, the Enforcer's glasses stay amber in places, some gold survives on shoes.

B. Fresh takes per role (Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo)

14 per role: 11 open briefs plus 3 blends (the 008 sheet's cohesion, bone and dark seafoam-teal with a coral lining flash, but cut sharper, no brass, faces open). Each prompt starts from a one-line personality hook. Open takes use a charcoal base, one off-white panel and one accent from: deep teal-black, burnt sienna, bone, slate.

C. Team lineups (Qwen Image 2.1 Turbo)

C. Round 1 (kept as evidence: the four drifted into a matching squad uniform with cargo trousers and belts, i.e. tactical costume)

Round 2 adds a silhouette recipe per role (Scout: short jacket and pack; Fixer: one long slim line; Tech: loose vest or apron; Enforcer: biggest, long heavy coat) and bans cargo trousers, belts and matching tops.

D. Model comparison: same prompt, Qwen Turbo (left) and Codex (right)

Codex prompts are the same text plus the runner's standard margin sentence (D1-D5). Qwen: 17 s and $0.014 per image, seeded and repeatable. Codex: about 1 to 2 minutes, free, unseeded.

promptStylised character concept art for a video game, in the manner of a polished character design sheet: full body head to toe, one person, an expressive three-quarter pose with attitude that shows personality (never a stiff catalogue pose), a bold readable silhouette, plain warm light-grey studio backdrop with a soft ground shadow. A woman in her 40s, Korean, lean and upright, short grey-streaked hair, the Scout of a small crew: the one who watches. Personality: A former surveyor who notices everything and says little. Face: calm narrowed eyes, a closed-mouth half smile, weathered cheeks. Clothes: fitted high-collar overshirt over a long-sleeve base layer, tapered trousers, low flat boots, a slim tall pack frame on her back, built from sharp colour blocks: charcoal and ink-black base, one cool off-white panel, and deep teal-black as the single accent. Telling detail: a folding measuring rule in her hand and a pencil behind her ear. Design lineage: a visitor from a nearby timeline, sharper and cleaner than any local; a memorable cut with a sculpted collar, asymmetric closures and layered panels; matte technical fabrics, clean seams, brushed chrome and matte metal hardware; no gold, no brass, no deco ornament, no period tailoring, no workwear uniform look, not cyberpunk, no neon, no glowing parts. Bare open face, no mask, no sunglasses, no helmet. Finish: polished matte painted digital character concept art, crisp clean edges, slightly stylised proportions, soft even studio light, an expressive believable face. No text, no logos, no watermark.
